lead: `bun nv holes` keys on the refusal *phrase*, not on the macro.
body: A site reworded from `panic!` to `unreachable!` still counts as a hole while its message matches `REFUSAL` in `tools/nv/cmd/holes.ts` ("does not lower", "only lowers", "no lowering for"); there is no allowlist and no attribute. The last edit of a slice that answers a hole at the checker is to reword the assert to state what reached lowering and name the code that refuses it ("… reached lowering: … refuses this where it is written, as `E0494`"), or the worklist you quote is one higher than the tree.
